Bluetooth body fat weight scale is your healthy assistant, which can measure 12 body metrics to show on OKOK APP. Bluetooth scale supports you and your family to share one scale to manage health metrics and improve health condition. Keep you and your family healthy.

Features:
Easy to setup
Tracks 12 metrics over time
Auto recognize family members, available for 8 person
Share weight loss progress with friends on APP easily
No battery inquired for rechargeable version

Powerful 12-in-1 Measurement:
1.Weight
2.BMI
3.Body Fat
4.Muscle
5.Water
6.V-Fat
7.Bone Mass
8.Metabolism
9.Protein
10.Obesity Degree
11.Body Age
12.Non Fat Weight

Specification:
Maximum capacity: 180kg
Range of age: 10-80 years

For USB Charge type, how long can it last after a full charge?

It will last more than a month after full charge. Please charge 8 hours before first use as recommended by our manufacturer.


Product Specification:

Smart Scale: Bluetooth 4.0 (connect both IOS & Android smartphone) 📲📲

Color Choice: Black, White

Machine Size: 260x260mm

Machine Thickness: 23mm

Display Mode: LCD display

Bearing Range: 0.1kg-180kg

***Warm tips: DO NOT put on carpet & yoga mat***
